items.title: the peer-push test was reverted from main (b0b0afd; its commit fbdef92 is in main history). Both tests fail in the full suite (v1 !== v1X) while standing alone and under bounded c8 they pass; the first deliverable is a proof that fails at base, not only in suite order — until then the red gate parks it. Patch: $LOOP/p50-crash/a2-wip.patch
`.Fn` in a SYNOPSIS also ends with `;` in groff; we do not print it (found in p61's report)
no fake emits a typed-array chunk split mid-UTF-8, so `js/shell.mjs`'s streaming decoder is proven only by real-pty timing; add the fake and the test
items.notes: coverage-only: the streaming decoder is already correct, so its test passes at base and the red gate parks it. Give it a measure proof or a gate that accepts coverage, then dispatch.

items.title: `flushPeer`'s `catch { return }` treats a throwing `sendableUpdates` as already flushed, so a broken collab field skips the wait silently (found in p50's report)
`strace-log-merge(1)`, `mendex(1)`, `gpg(1)`, `man(1)` residuals (1-2 words each)
a colon list reports the last failing candidate; with a mode-000 part before a missing one it names the missing one
`tbl(1)`/`gtbl(1)`'s example table prints `eleven;11` where man prints `eleven 11`
an `%A`-only `.Rs` ends with a period; groff ends with a comma (no corpus occurrence)
a no-output request between a `\c` and the next line swallows the join (0 corpus occurrences)
a `\c` followed by a blank line: groff joins to the next text line, we make a paragraph break
a text line after `.br` starts with a space (`test/man-parse.mjs:2470` enshrines it); groff has none
`.Rv`/`.Ex` `-exit` and `-nop` (Man.md gap 2)
after a macro under `.Sm off`, a text line still gets a space (groff joins it)
`\v(`-delimited arguments are read as a 2-char name (no corpus use found)
`.nr x +N` / `.nr x -N` set the register; groff adds/subtracts (found in p27)
a man page with no `.TH` loads no macro package in groff: man(1) drops the `.SH` headings and prints U+2010; we render headings (pcre2demo(3)) — refuse or mimic?
`\c` joins forward only (ext2/3/4.5 `trackingfile`)
`\F` and `\m \M \k \S \v` take their own forms (kernel-install `THE TION`, git-subtree, mflua)
`.Sm off` starts suppressing at the second call (ssh_config `PermitRemoteOpen host:port`)
ssh(1) synopsis `-D [bind_address:]port`: fixed by p14
a readable whole `man -w` line wins over its split parts (Man.md gap 3)
`.Lb` maps through groff's table (9 libcrypt pages)
`.In` prints `#include <...>` in SYNOPSIS (47 pages)
`.do` runs its remainder instead of printing it (11 pages)
`\n+[reg]` steps then reads (sensible-editor 1-5, zlib 1-3)
a whole `man -w` line that stats as a file is settled by its read
one `Cannot read <path>: <reason>` shape
`man-diff` joins at a `\:` the page marks, not at every "/"
a justified paragraph is not a table (hgrc `forthe`)
a bordered cell's continuation at the left edge (TIFFGetField 6 → 0)
a background subagent is launched, not finished (tick, routing, ⏳)
`.Rs` quotes `%T` only in a `%B`/`%J` reference, and takes groff's serial comma (14 ssh references)
a `\c` tag line stays open across a macro (paperconfig `--paperpapername`, 5 dmstats tags)
a colon-list part with no read bits says `Permission denied`
lzma verdict: the header bytes are destroyed by the UTF-8 decode, so no safe sniff; `lzcat` already last
the truncated mdoc banner is a header (5 pages, 31 → 1 words)
the `\:` join accepts ":" (`bash(1)` 4 → 2)
the `\:` join accepts "@" (`troff(1)` 2 → 0)
a bare `.Nm` in a `T{`/`T}` cell prints the document name (both crypt pages 0)
`man-diff --page` prints `lost <n>` before the sample
verdict: no mdoc U+2010 rule; `man-diff` folds U+2010/U+2011/U+2212 (pcre2demo 67 → 12)
`.hla`/`.hpf` are no-output requests; both Czech pages parse (corpus back to 4123/27)
the `cat` fallback keeps its bytes, so the renderer names a mislabelled page's format (the app half is p63)
`man-diff` folds typographic quotes; pcre2demo 12 → 0 (U+2018 folds to a backtick)
the hyphen join is decided from the page source and applied to both sides; section 3 14 → 0
coverage re-measured over the whole suite: 100/99.97/100/100/98.88 line, branch 94.56/98.75/97.18/90.28
`.Fc` ends a SYNOPSIS declaration with `;`, and only in SYNOPSIS
the pty's bytes cross IPC as Buffers; one streaming decoder per run; the real-pty test names gzip
stabilisation after the red merge: `Opt.load` survives a payload-less response, the opt tests install their own fake; a2's peer-push test reverted (p50)
a .Ss subsection inside SYNOPSIS resets the section state, so .Fn and .Fc lose the ; (groff keeps doc-in-synopsis-section across .Ss; no installed page hits it)
a colon-list part with read bits whose read fails ranks with a missing part, so a later miss can still shadow it; no test covers that ordering
